rows.note: Use 問題 as the all-purpose word for an ordinary question, a topic or issue, or a matter whose validity is at issue.

example.english: I have a question to ask you.
example.jyutping: ngo5 jau5 tiu4 man6 tai4 soeng2 man6 nei5

rows.note: Use 疑問 when emphasizing an unresolved doubt or a question someone still has, rather than a general issue.

example.english: This answer still leaves me with a question.
example.traditional: 呢個答案令我仲有疑問。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 daap3 on3 ling6 ngo5 zung6 jau5 ji4 man6

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for asking someone questions or seeking information.

example.english: I want to ask you a question about what time the meeting starts.
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 man6 haa5 nei5 gei2 dim2 hoi1 wui2

rows.note: Use this when asking persistent follow-up questions or pressing someone for more information.

example.english: They would not explain, so I had to question them further.
example.traditional: 佢唔肯講，我唯有追問落去。
example.jyutping: keoi5 m4 hang2 gong2 ngo5 wai4 jau5 zeoi1 man6 lok6 heoi3

rows.note: Use this when questioning something means doubting whether it is true or reliable.

example.english: I question whether this email is a scam.
example.traditional: 我懷疑呢封電郵係呃人嘅。
example.jyutping: ngo5 waai4 ji4 ni1 fung1 din6 jau4 hai6 aak1 jan4 ge3

rows.note: Use this, especially in formal or written contexts, when actively challenging a claim or assertion rather than merely doubting it.

example.english: The committee began to question the data in the report.
example.traditional: 委員會質疑報告入面嘅數據。
example.jyutping: wai2 jyun4 wui2 zat1 ji4 bou3 gou3 jap6 min6 ge3 sou3 geoi3
